# PODIUM — Effet de Sol

> Independent motorsport engineering publication, interactive 3D FP-04 RB technical showroom and 47-assembly disassembly studio, and live 2024–2026 Formula 1 season race data (EN/VI).

## Core Sections

- [Overview](https://podiumeds.pages.dev/): Storm Midnight editorial overview with synchronized next-race countdown, championship pulse, and interactive 3D entry points.
- [2026 Season Hub](https://podiumeds.pages.dev/season/2026): Live 2026 Grand Prix results, sprint classifications, calendar, and driver/constructor standings.
- [3D FP-04 RB Showroom](https://podiumeds.pages.dev/showroom): Interactive 2-bay 3D F1 garage featuring 11 2026 liveries and live pit-crew wheel service.
- [Engineering Disassembly Studio](https://podiumeds.pages.dev/engineering): 12-scene interactive 3D FP-04 RB aerodynamic disassembly across 47 assemblies plus original technical essays.
- [Drivers Directory](https://podiumeds.pages.dev/drivers): Driver dossiers, season statistics, and team affiliations (2024–2026).
- [Teams Directory](https://podiumeds.pages.dev/teams): Constructor profiles, chassis specifications, and season histories.
- [About & Sources](https://podiumeds.pages.dev/about): Editorial methodology, public data attribution, and copyright transparency.

## Engineering Articles

- [Ground Effect: Creating Downforce Under the Car](https://podiumeds.pages.dev/engineering/ground-effect-aerodynamics): How floor geometry, floor edges, and the diffuser manage pressure beneath a ground-effect racing prototype.
- [Active Aerodynamics and Wing Mechanics](https://podiumeds.pages.dev/engineering/active-aerodynamics-wing-mechanics): From wing sections and slots to actuation, locking, and fail-safe thinking in a switchable aerodynamic system.
- [Hybrid Powertrains and Energy Management](https://podiumeds.pages.dev/engineering/hybrid-powertrains-energy-management): Following energy from fuel and battery to the driven wheels, then back to storage through regenerative braking.
- [Vehicle Dynamics and Suspension](https://podiumeds.pages.dev/engineering/vehicle-dynamics-suspension): How tyres, suspension, and the aerodynamic platform share load under braking, acceleration, and cornering.

## Discovery & Machine-Readable Endpoints

- [XML Sitemap](https://podiumeds.pages.dev/sitemap.xml): Canonical index of all public routes, drivers, teams, cars, and engineering articles.
- [ARD Manifest](https://podiumeds.pages.dev/.well-known/ard.json): Agentic Resource Discovery JSON manifest.
